correctness.rationale: Rhombic dodecahedron has 8 cubic and 6 axial vertices with 24 axial-cubic edges. A generic central section polygon vertex is a sign-changing edge crossing. Signed-coordinate permutations reduce generic normals to a>=b>=c>0 and only the chambers a<b+c (cube 6, rhombic 6) and a>b+c (cube 4, rhombic 8). Haar area of the spherical triangle with side pi/3 yields P(6,6)=1-6 asin(1/3)/pi and complement P(4,8). Independent exact sign edge-crossing tests for integer generic normals in [-4,4]^3 reproduced both classes; degeneracies explicitly excluded.
